stem.text: Forces are applied to the ends of a rod so that its length increases. The variation with force $F$ of the extension $e$ of the rod is shown.

stem.alt: Graph of extension e against force F, starting at the origin, with a straight line to a point labelled P and a curve continuing above P to the right.

stem.text: The point P is the elastic limit.
Which shaded area represents the work done during the plastic deformation of the rod?

A.alt: Graph of e against F with a straight line to point P, a curve above P, and a shaded area under the curve between the axes and a vertical dashed line at the end of the curve.

B.alt: Graph of e against F with a straight line to point P, a curve above P, and a shaded area above the line from the vertical axis to the curve, bounded by a horizontal dashed line.

C.alt: Graph of e against F with a straight line to point P, a curve above P, and a shaded area between the vertical axis and the curve, bounded by horizontal dashed lines.

D.alt: Graph of e against F with a straight line to point P, a curve above P, and a shaded area between a vertical dashed line at P and a vertical dashed line at the end of the curve, under the curve.
